summary: A vulnerability was identified in makeplane plane up to 1.4.2. Impacted is an unknown function of...
description: A vulnerability was identified in makeplane plane up to 1.4.2. Impacted is an unknown function of the component API Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument X-Forwarded-For leads to reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

summary: A vulnerability was determined in datastax pulsar-jms up to 9.0.3. This issue affects the...
description: A vulnerability was determined in datastax pulsar-jms up to 9.0.3. This issue affects the function decode of the file pulsar-jms/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/pulsar/jms/messages/PulsarObjectMessage.java. This manipulation causes deserialization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

However, it was not possible to determine the PR or commit which could have fixed this issue.

summary: A security flaw has been discovered in THU-MIG yoloe up to...
description: A security flaw has been discovered in THU-MIG yoloe up to 40cd606cabdbe2b566d6f14a6b162c89206e9a1b. This affects the function eval of the file ultralytics/nn/autobackend.py of the component AutoBackend Model Loading. The manipulation of the argument imgsz/names/kpt_shape results in improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. This product does not use versioning. This is why information about affected and unaffected releases are unavailable. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

cwes.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

summary: Coder from 2.26.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in the GET /api/v2...
description: Coder from 2.26.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in the GET /api/v2/workspaces/{id}/acl endpoint, which checks only workspace read access and then fetches group members using an elevated system context. Authenticated users granted workspace use access can query the endpoint to harvest group members' emails, login types, status, and last-seen and creation timestamps.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

summary: Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an open redirect vulnerability in handleAPIKeySmuggling...
description: Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an open redirect vulnerability in handleAPIKeySmuggling that allows attackers to redirect users externally via unsanitized r.URL.Path values. Attackers can craft links on trusted workspace app subdomains with paths beginning with double slashes, which become scheme-relative redirects to attacker sites for phishing.

cwes.name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

description: Coder before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contains a user enumeration vulnerability because userpassword.Compare() substitutes a placeholder hash derived from the string "hunter2" when a stored password hash is empty. Unauthenticated attackers can submit logins with the password "hunter2" and distinguish HTTP 403 from 401 responses to enumerate valid accounts and reveal the authentication provider of SSO-only users.

summary: Coder before 2.34.7 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability in the ExtractRealIPAddress middleware...
description: Coder before 2.34.7 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability in the ExtractRealIPAddress middleware that trusts the leftmost, client-supplied X-Forwarded-For value instead of the client IP appended by a reverse proxy. Attackers can send forged X-Forwarded-For values through appending proxies to bypass per-IP rate limits on login, one-time passcode, and password validation endpoints, enabling brute-force attacks, and to falsify IP addresses recorded in audit logs.

Coder before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability because the ApplicationName and LogoURL appearance settings are rendered into HTML output without sufficient escaping. Attackers with the Owner role can store HTML markup in these settings that renders in the Coder dashboard and in SMTP notification emails sent to other deployment users.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

summary: Coder from 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the provisioner...
description: Coder from 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the provisioner daemon DownloadFile gRPC handler that allows authenticated provisioner daemons to download other organizations' cached Terraform module archives. Attackers with an org-scoped provisioner key and a known file UUID can retrieve module source code exposing infrastructure topology or embedded secrets.

summary: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an unbounded recursion vulnerability in Apple MDM enrollment...
description: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an unbounded recursion vulnerability in Apple MDM enrollment property list parsing that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server. Attackers can send a crafted binary plist payload of about 150 bytes to the enrollment endpoints, triggering exponential allocation or infinite recursion that exhausts CPU and memory.

summary: Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the acl_allow...
description: Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the acl_allow rule of coderd/rbac/policy.rego, which does not verify organization membership for per-user ACL entries, and organization member removal does not scrub those entries. Authenticated users removed from an organization can keep accessing previously granted org-scoped resources such as templates and workspaces via the API.

summary: Coder from 2.10.0 before 2.34.8 has an unauthenticated agent debug HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:2113...
description: Coder from 2.10.0 before 2.34.8 has an unauthenticated agent debug HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:2113 whose /debug/manifest handler returns the full agent manifest, including template-provided environment variable values. A lower-privileged Unix user or process in the same workspace can query this endpoint to read credentials such as cloud keys or registry tokens.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

description: Coder before 2.29.20, 2.33.0 before 2.33.12, 2.34.0 before 2.34.8, and 2.35.0 before 2.35.4 contains an improper hostname validation flaw in GetWorkspaceProxyByHostname whose SIMILAR TO pattern performs a prefix match, so any domain that is a string prefix of a workspace-proxy access URL is trusted as a proxy. Attackers owning such a domain can lure an authenticated victim to a crafted /api/v2/applications/auth-redirect link, capture the redirected application_connect API key, and replay it to access the victim's workspace apps.

summary: Fleet before 4.83.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated...
description: Fleet before 4.83.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory by sending gzip-compressed request bodies. Attackers can send small, highly compressed requests with Content-Encoding: gzip to unauthenticated endpoints that expand during decoding, crashing the entire Fleet instance.

cwes.name: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)

summary: Vikunja 0.13.0 before 2.7.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows project...
description: Vikunja 0.13.0 before 2.7.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows project members with Write permission to delete admin-tier link shares because the delete permission check reads an unloaded share object. Attackers can send DELETE requests to the v1 or v2 projects shares endpoints with sequential share IDs to revoke admin links and invalidate existing share sessions.

summary: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.0 contains a permissive CORS configuration that trusts every...
description: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.0 contains a permissive CORS configuration that trusts every localhost and 127.0.0.1 port with credentials, even when service.publicurl is set. Attackers controlling a page on any localhost port can send a credentialed request to the token refresh endpoint and read the returned bearer JWT to take over the logged-in user's account.

cwes.name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains

summary: Vikunja 2.6.0 contains a broken access control flaw in getProjectAccessForUser (pkg/models...
description: Vikunja 2.6.0 contains a broken access control flaw in getProjectAccessForUser (pkg/models/project_access.go), which resolves a user's effective project permission as the maximum over the project tree, silently overriding explicit lower-permission shares on sub-projects. A collaborator with write access on a parent project but read-only access to a child project can modify the child project's tasks and content.
